module_summary: Round-robin arbiter: a double-width masked priority trick picks a grant from a one-hot priority pointer, locks it until accept_i, then rotates priority.

anchors.name: prio_q
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin pointer, rotated past the granted requester on accept.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector output from gnt_q.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Request vector feeding priority selection and lock trigger.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Acknowledge releasing the lock, rotating priority and clearing grant.

anchors.name: gnt_valid_o
anchors.why: Grant valid output, mirrors locked_q while grant is held.

anchors.name: dbl_gnt
anchors.why: Combinational masked-priority grant, folded into gnt_d when unlocked.

groups.name: priority_select
groups.description: Double-width priority search from round-robin pointer producing the grant register.

groups.name: grant_lock
groups.description: Lock flag holding the grant until accept, then rotating priority.
